title: Raw native rules grant LibModSecurity filesystem and process output authority outside the case root
title_de: Rohe native Regeln verleihen LibModSecurity Dateisystem- und Prozessausgabeautorität außerhalb der Case-Wurzel
protocol: native rule to LibModSecurity authority boundary
summary: Raw native case rules could override audit/debug output configuration and select Library resource/process/CWD-sensitive behaviors, causing LibModSecurity to open an external sibling path after Parent runtime-root preparation.
summary_de: Rohe native Case-Regeln konnten Audit-/Debug-Ausgabekonfiguration überschreiben und Library-Ressourcen-/Prozess-/CWD-sensitive Verhaltensweisen wählen, wodurch LibModSecurity nach Parent-Runtime-Root-Vorbereitung einen externen benachbarten Pfad öffnete.
observed_behavior: A controlled native case used SecDebugLog/SecAuditLog overrides to create external Library output. Final-symlink variations likewise reached the unsafe output class before the rule gate.
observed_behavior_de: Ein kontrollierter nativer Case nutzte SecDebugLog-/SecAuditLog-Overrides, um externe Library-Ausgabe zu erzeugen. Finale Symlink-Varianten erreichten vor dem Regel-Gate ebenfalls die unsichere Ausgabeklasse.
expected_behavior: Rules may not authorize Library pathname, resource, process, or unowned CWD effects. Parent-owned result/server-log descriptors and a verified 0700 CWD remain the only permitted native output/state channel.
expected_behavior_de: Regeln dürfen keine Library-Pfad-, Ressourcen-, Prozess- oder unbesessenen CWD-Effekte autorisieren. Parent-besessene Ergebnis-/Server-Log-Deskriptoren und ein verifizierter 0700-CWD bleiben der einzige zulässige native Ausgabe-/State-Kanal.
impact: A case author could write or influence files outside the verified native case root, invoke external side effects, or consume mutable CWD-relative state through LibModSecurity.
impact_de: Ein Case-Autor konnte über LibModSecurity Dateien außerhalb der verifizierten nativen Case-Wurzel schreiben oder beeinflussen, externe Seiteneffekte auslösen oder veränderbaren CWD-relativen State konsumieren.
preconditions: A raw native rule reaches the Parent native comparison runner.
LibModSecurity parses the rule before the fixed rule-authority gate.
reproduction: Supply SecDebugLog or SecAuditLog with a sibling external path.
Run the native comparison and observe the Library output before the fix.
Repeat with a pre-created final symlink and preserve an external sentinel after the fix.

evidence.command: rtk env PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 TMPDIR=<task-run>/tmp /root/git/ModSecurity-conector/.venv/bin/python -B -m unittest -v tests.test_runtime_env_snapshot_contract; rtk clang/gcc C17 static checks

root_cause: The Parent safely prepared case paths but then treated untrusted rule text as authority for LibModSecurity internal file/resource/process APIs. Parent audit/debug preamble directives could be overridden and CWD/state were not fully descriptor-bound.
root_cause_de: Der Parent bereitete Case-Pfade sicher vor, behandelte danach aber untrusted Regeltext als Autorität für interne Datei-/Ressourcen-/Prozess-APIs von LibModSecurity. Parent-Audit-/Debug-Präambel-Direktiven konnten überschrieben werden, und CWD/State waren nicht vollständig deskriptorgebunden.
proposed_remediation: PR C fail-closes unsafe rule directives/operators/actions, removes Library audit/debug pathname preamble, retains only Parent-owned output FDs, and verifies a private state-directory FD before fchdir.
proposed_remediation_de: PR C weist unsichere Regel-Direktiven/-Operatoren/-Aktionen fail-closed ab, entfernt die Library-Audit-/Debug-Pfadpräambel, behält nur Parent-besessene Output-FDs und prüft einen privaten State-Verzeichnis-FD vor fchdir.
acceptance_criteria: Original and final-symlink audit/debug rules are rejected before the C Oracle and do not alter a foreign sentinel.
A legitimate initcol/setvar control succeeds with status 200 and descriptor-owned CWD/output FDs.
validation_plan: Run native rule materialization/oracle tests and real local LibModSecurity control/PoCs.
Compile changed C with C17 and static analysis.
Verify the exact delivery PR head; retain Framework/MRTS matrix absence as a gap.
dependencies: FND-PARENT-0033 supplies shared descriptor-safe runtime primitives.
blocked_by: Full Framework/MRTS native-matrix integration is blocked_missing_evidence.
deduplication_note: Distinct from FND-PARENT-0033 because the unsafe authority begins after safe case-root allocation in raw rules/Library APIs; distinct from FND-PARENT-0036 because lifetime cleanup is independent of rule parsing/output paths.
residual_risk: The Parent rule/Oracle boundary is fixed locally but delivery-pending until remote exact-head CI/review. Unrun Framework/MRTS matrix behavior is an evidence gap, not a relaxation of the rule gate.
residual_risk_de: Die Parent-Regel-/Oracle-Grenze ist lokal fixed, aber delivery-pending bis zu Remote-Exact-Head-CI/Review. Nicht ausgeführtes Framework-/MRTS-Matrixverhalten ist eine Evidenzlücke, keine Lockerung des Regel-Gates.

history.detail: Real Library audit/debug escape evidence and focused exact-head tests support the separate PR-C remediation.
